reachAndCapacity.note: The west chair uses O16, the southern pair share O47, and Echo serves the new eastern sofa end. O06 stays for the central sofa seats/west chair. Not all eight seats can reach one central coffee table; local tables resolve this without shrinking chairs or blocking the main route.

designTradeoffs: Extend only the eastern sofa end to-30deg while keeping west165deg fixed.195deg covers54.2% of the full circle and about83.7% of the retained CAD enclosure; the southwest opening stays clear.
Three1000x880 O11 chairs require an asymmetric west/southwest/southeast arrangement. Local chair gaps about480mm and east-chair/sofa gap about402mm are seat access, not a second1200mm aisle.
Keep a continuous1200mm main approach west/southwest; its nearest furniture edge has about70mm extra margin and model-floor boundary about75mm extra margin.
O06 shifts100mm west and150mm south from the expanded layout. It remains about496mm from the sofa conservative edge. The eastern sofa seat uses Echo; southern loose chairs share O47.
Echo uses its full official457.2mm square footprint; it was not forced into a450mm circle. O16 diameter430mm and O47 diagonal500mm remain planning sizes pending supplier confirmation.
Eastern chair has only about145mm to the retained30mm-finished arc near the southeast enclosure end. This is furniture/wall allowance, not passage; preserve access around the southwest side instead.

No rear walkway is possible behind the large sofa:308mm after main finish is maintenance allowance. The C2 secondary connection supports a local1100mm band in the current model, with small tolerances requiring final site checks.

Kasthall4100x3750mm is a proposed custom quotation size. Both southern chairs straddle the rug edge with front supports intended on it; exact support positions and weaving-width feasibility require confirmation.
